author: Ingigo
body: Hello there, I am Ingigo, and today I am writing to you because you lot think I am using Anti-Knockback. Are you being ridiculous? There is a technique to get no kb. And you can clearly see me take knockback in the flipping video. In the flipping game, I took knockback, heck, look at Ques and WorldPeace then if you think I am using anti-knockback. Are you <removed>? Look at this video, about the technique. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ulr5rhdCCfM So that was the technique I was using. So, what are you trying to say? I clearly took knockback, are you blind? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bkx2YLxh7B0&feature=youtu.be So this is your video? Get the recording of Ques and WorldPeace, 99250, lol, they took no knockback. Lol, hilarious. So idiotic. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lPYwXhkeNYk That is anti-knockback, in the video 99250, I clearly took knockback, half a block, look at it closely, I moved backwards. Look clearly before banning me lol. I am fed up with you staff, lol, I used anti-knockback, lolwot. Also, this is the scrim server we were in this video, look clearly, I take knockback, even 99250 knocked me back 5 blocks, how do you explain that? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L_6jX2V3QQQ One is 6:49 to 6:53, play at 0.25 as the video is sped up, look, I was knocked back, how the heck do you explain that if I use anti-kb? 6:37, 0.25 speed, how do I take kb if I use hacks? 2:54, 0.25, how did I get knocked back, oh wait, Anti-KB hacks, clearly, ohmai. Check other sources first rather than thinking I hack. Idiotic.

replies.body:
Hello,

Firstly can I say calling staff 'retarded' is not the way to get appealed, I know you're mad, but no need for that. Many others have had this 'bias' knockback and can be mis judged easily and banned for hacks.
-Appealed

Regards,
Auratix_,
Senior Moderator
